editorial:
Jane, a struggling actress who loves getting high, eats her roommate's pot-laced cupcakes by mistake and spends the rest of the day running around Los Angeles trying to fix her mess. What follows is a wild, funny ride through the city as she tries to handle simple tasks that turn into big problems. Anna Faris carries the whole movie with her goofy, lovable energy, making you laugh even when Jane makes terrible choices. The movie feels like a fun, chaotic adventure that never slows down, and you will find yourself rooting for Jane even as she keeps digging herself deeper into trouble.

Gregg Araki directs with a light touch, keeping things moving fast and never letting the jokes get stale. The supporting cast, including John Krasinski and Adam Brody, adds extra laughs along the way. Some jokes land better than others, and the humor is very stoner-focused, so it may not be for everyone. If you enjoy silly, laid-back comedies with a great lead performance, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Jane's chaotic day finally winds down at a carnival. After a series of mishaps, she ends up on a Ferris wheel with a guy she likes, still completely stoned. The twist is that the cupcakes she ate at the start were far stronger than she realized, meaning she has been high the entire movie. She smiles, realizing she survived the day, and the movie ends on that happy, hazy note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stoner comedies and silly, laid-back humor.
